Along a desolate stretch of California desert highway, next to a ramshackle home, law enforcement officials on Wednesday dug for a second day in a search for bodies.

Detectives working a homicide investigation discovered the remains of two people on Tuesday in a  remote area of Lancaster, authorities said.

They resumed digging at a sprawling and decaying property, shifting the focus from a battered greenhouse that was the center of attention Tuesday to an area nearer a home. KTLA’s Sky 5 helicopter captured medical examiner investigators and L.A. County Sheriff’s personnel working beneath a tent on the property strewn with old cars and detritus.

Pressure is mounting on Anaheim Mayor Ashleigh Aitken as more City Council members speak out over allegations that she used racial slurs against her chief of staff.

Three council members are now pushing for the city to move quickly on an investigation into the accusations, while calls are also growing for officials to make public the documents outlining the claims.

The controversy surfaced after Aitken’s chief of staff, Berenice Ballinas, accused the mayor of making racist and homophobic remarks directed at her, the LA Times’ Daily Pilot.
